items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: Well, he's the one who learned me how to pick banjo, you see.

ctx.x: Well, he's the one who learned me how to pick banjo, you see. When I was bad, I used to run across him all the time, you know. He's got a ban now, you know.
Well, I asked him about, did anybody take a hot chorus and play chords? Or did they always pick it?
